rule: A six-cell Base Candidate is justified only when a change touches l1_path_prefixes or l1_exact_paths. Other tree changes must not require that lane.
notes: This is the intended freeze surface, not a claim that the PE is already thin.
agenterm-platform types may stay linked from L1; growing resource inventories belongs in L2 data or cu.
dyn trampoline (native.rs) is L1; dyn host-fact catalog rows are L2 data.
src/bin/agenterm-cc.rs is an App/L2-or-L3 PE, not L1.
Workflow edits that only add an App/L2 lane must not be classified as L1.
